obligations.why: Every PR passes the checks AGENTS.md lists before a PR, with no test skipped that is not allowed to skip

A feature or fix merges only after an agent that did not write it has used it on the box as a signed-in person, and put the verdict on the PR (AGENTS.md, Check Features on the Box). Test, CI and docs PRs owe none

owes.what: another agent uses the change on the box, on a build that contains this PR, and posts the verdict on the PR
owes.how: AGENTS.md, Check Features on the Box: pnpm verify box plan, prepare, cli, identity, then another agent's check

obligations.why: A change a person can see (a screen, a dialog, copy, styling, a CLI's output) carries screenshots of every state it touches, with main beside it when it alters an existing screen

owes.what: a screenshot of every state the change touches, before and after
owes.how: the verify skill's drivers for web, TUI, desktop, mobile-web and VS Code

obligations.why: First server setup on a real Docker engine: volume ownership and the official Postgres bootstrap. They skip unless given a disposable Docker context; CI's docker-suites job runs them when these paths change

ciLanes.command: the packaging job's node --test list in .github/workflows/ci.yml (needs Docker, Helm, OpenTofu and Chromium), then pnpm --filter @sealant/mend test:package
node scripts/docker-suites.mjs (needs Docker; pulls postgres:17-alpine and node:26-trixie)
pnpm --filter @mend/api-server test:preview-acceptance (needs Docker, Postgres, Chromium and Firefox)
MEND_TEST_VERSION=<a server image built from this commit> VSCODE_BIN=<VS Code's Electron binary> pnpm --filter ./apps/vscode test:e2e (needs Docker, VS Code and Xvfb; about 6 minutes)
